dialogue.Introduction: Oh! Hello there, @. I'm the Golfer, and up here at 1 River Road I'm practising my swing as often as I can. Fore, by the way. Always fore!$h
dialogue.Mon: Monday. Perfect weather for a practice swing, if you ask me. Mind the garden fence, I've already put one ball through the hedge.
dialogue.Tue: Tuesday is my day to putt on the lawn. Par is a state of mind, and my mind is currently at bogey.
dialogue.Wed: Wednesday. A little birdie told me the valley could use a proper golf course. I'm working on it, one hole at a time.
dialogue.Thu: Thursday means walking the whole river path with my driver over my shoulder. The locals stare, but it's great for the swing.
dialogue.Fri: Friday! Half the valley is heading for the saloon. I'd rather be on the green, but a cold drink wouldn't go amiss.
dialogue.Sat: Saturday, and the sun is just right for a round. I'd invite you along, but you'd probably steal my best ball.$h
dialogue.Sun: Sunday is my rest day. Even golfers rest, though I usually spend it watching the Princess try to hit her tee shots without a slice.
dialogue.Mon2: You're back? Come on then, watch my stance. Keep your head down, that's the whole secret.$h
dialogue.Tue2: If you see a golf ball lying in the grass, don't kick it. It's been on a long journey and it's very tired.
dialogue.Thu6: I've been thinking about my swing a lot lately, @. Turns out it's easier to get it right when you're watching.$l
dialogue.Wed6: Do you know what a birdie is? It's one under par, and it's the only thing that makes my day better than a sunny morning.$h
dialogue.Fri10: Would you like to know my secret golf dream? A course on the beach, with you holding the flag and me holding your hand.$l
dialogue.Sat2: A proper round needs three things: a good club, a flat green and good company. I have two out of three right now.$h
dialogue.Sun2: Sunday again. I've already finished my laundry, my clubs and my tea. Only you are left on the list.$l
dialogue.Mon4: @, you're one of the few people who doesn't mind hearing about my golf. That means more to me than a hole in one.$h
dialogue.Tue4: The Princess and I ended up at River Road by a bet on a river crossing. Long story. I'll tell you when the weather is nicer.
dialogue.Wed4: The Stylist says I'm too serious about my hobby. She's right, but a man has to have something to swing at.$h
dialogue.Thu4: I think best on a walk with my clubs. You're welcome to come along if you can keep up and don't mind the sand traps.
dialogue.Fri4: Friday evenings are the best time for a round. Maybe next week we could walk the beach together?$l
dialogue.Sat4: Saturday again. Honestly, my favourite part of the week is when you swing by and ask about my game.$h
dialogue.Sun4: Sundays are quiet at River Road. I like it that way, and I like it a little more when you're here.$l
dialogue.Mon8: I've carried a secret for ages. When I was young I wanted to play on a course far away. Then I found this valley and realised I liked the people more than the scores.$s
dialogue.Tue8: @, the Princess and I are family in all but name. I'd trust you with my last golf ball, and that's saying something.$h
dialogue.Wed8: Some days I worry I'm too stuck in my own game to notice the rest of the valley. You make me look up more often.$l
dialogue.Thu8: You know what scares me most? Not a blood moon, not a goblin army. It's the thought that one day you'd stop coming by.$s
dialogue.Fri8: When the valley got quiet during the bad nights, I kept thinking about how much I wanted you to be safe. Silly, but true.$l
dialogue.Sat8: Honest talk tonight: I'm happiest on a green with you chasing the ball across it, laughing at my terrible stance.$h
dialogue.Sun8: I've practised every swing this week so I'd look good in front of you. Silly, I know. Please stay a while anyway.$l
dialogue.danceRejection: Dance? Oh, @, I'd love to, but my feet belong on the green, not the dance floor. Ask me again when we're a little closer, alright?$s
dialogue.spring_Mon: Spring is the perfect time for a round. The grass is soft and the birds keep calling out the score.
dialogue.summer_Wed: Summer heat and golf do not mix. I'm carrying three bottles of water and a sunhat, and I still look like a boiled crab.
dialogue.fall_Fri: Fall leaves are a nightmare on the course. Half my balls end up in the piles, and I refuse to rake them.
dialogue.winter_Sat: Winter golf is brutal. Frozen fingers, frosted grass, and nobody wants to watch. You're one of the few who would, so thank you.$h
dialogue.summer_Sun: Sunday in summer means an early tee time before the heat. I'm up with the birds, and so are you, apparently.$h
dialogue.winter_Mon: Monday in winter means the clubs stay in the cupboard. I still practise my swing by the fire, very quietly.
dialogue.spring_Thu: Spring Thursday. The river is high and the bank is muddy, so my shoes are covered in more than just grass.
dialogue.fall_Tue: Tuesday in fall means the orchard smells like apples. Good for the soul, not so good for a clean putt.
dialogue.winter_Wed8: Cold Wednesday, warm heart. Walking with you in the snow is the only golf round I never want to end.$l
dialogue.spring_Sat4: Spring Saturday with you on the course. I think this might be the best swing I've taken all year.$h
dialogue.spring_15: Halfway through spring and the flowers are everywhere. The course looks like a painting, and I'm the lucky one holding the brush.
dialogue.fall_15: Halfway through fall. The leaves are falling and so is my score, but my mood is climbing.$h
dialogue.fall_20: Late fall means the course is nearly empty. Good news, that leaves more room for a proper walk with you.$l
dialogue.summer_7: Early summer, first round of the season. I'm nervous, and I'm not even sure it's the golf that makes me nervous.$u

rainy: Rain on the river means my golf balls float away. Not all bad, though. The Princess says I should stay in and tidy the clubs.

marriage.Indoor_Day_0: Good morning, dear. Breakfast is on the table and the clubs are by the door.
marriage.Indoor_Day_1: Indoors again? Fine by me, the rain has made the course far too soggy for a round.
marriage.Indoor_Day_2: I've been practising my swing in the living room. Mind the lamp, please.
marriage.Indoor_Day_3: Our home smells of coffee and fresh grass. Perfect for a lazy afternoon.
marriage.Indoor_Day_4: Come and sit with me. The Princess is out in the garden and I want you all to myself.
marriage.Rainy_Day_0: Rain on the roof and no golf today. A shame, but I still have you.
marriage.Rainy_Day_1: I hate rain, but I love watching it fall past the window with you beside me.
marriage.Rainy_Day_2: We could play cards. I promise I won't cheat. Mostly.
marriage.Rainy_Day_3: The River Road is a muddy mess. I'll be fine as long as you're here.
marriage.Rainy_Day_4: Rainy days are for cosy blankets and very bad golf jokes.
marriage.Indoor_Night_0: Long day, love. Let's sit down before the candles burn out.
marriage.Indoor_Night_1: The house is quiet tonight, just how I like it, now that you're in it.
marriage.Indoor_Night_2: Dinner was lovely. Let's do it again tomorrow, I'll cook the eggs properly this time.
marriage.Indoor_Night_3: I was thinking about the blood moon. I'm glad you're safe in here with me.
marriage.Indoor_Night_4: Good night, @. I'll leave the lamp on until you're sleepy.
marriage.Rainy_Night_0: The rain is loud tonight. I'm glad you're close beside me.
marriage.Rainy_Night_1: Listen to that drumming on the roof. It makes me want to fall asleep right now.
marriage.Rainy_Night_2: Good night, dear. I'll keep the blanket warm for you.
marriage.Rainy_Night_3: Stay close. The thunder is grumbling again.
marriage.Rainy_Night_4: Rain, you, and a warm bed. I could not ask for anything better.
marriage.Outdoor_0: What a beautiful day outside. Want to take a stroll along the river?
marriage.Outdoor_1: The grass is perfect for a putt. Come and help me set the flag.
marriage.Outdoor_2: I can see the mountain from here. Strange how it looks smaller with you beside me.
marriage.Outdoor_3: The breeze is lovely. Let's sit on the bench for a bit.
marriage.Outdoor_4: The valley is looking gorgeous today. So is the person next to me.
marriage.Good_0: Oh, you're home! I was just wondering when you'd be back.
marriage.Good_1: Hello, dear. I saved you the last cookie, don't tell anyone.
marriage.Good_2: Things are going well today. I feel like I could sink every putt.
marriage.Good_3: I'm in such a good mood I might even sing. Please don't stop me.
marriage.Good_4: You always make the morning brighter, @. Truly.
marriage.Good_5: Let's go for a walk. The grass smells sweet today.
marriage.Good_6: Our tea tastes better when we drink it together.
marriage.Good_7: I was thinking about you on the green and missed the hole twice. Worth it.
marriage.Good_8: I'm the luckiest golfer in the valley, and that's not a line I say often.
marriage.Good_9: You know what? I love this life. Mostly because you're in it.
marriage.Neutral_0: Mm? Oh, hi. Sorry, I was counting how many balls the Princess has lost in the hedge.
marriage.Neutral_1: The clubs need polishing and the lawn needs mowing. Busy, busy.
marriage.Neutral_2: Do you mind if I sit quietly for a bit? My head is full of scores.
marriage.Neutral_3: Dinner is in the oven. Give me ten minutes, love.
marriage.Neutral_4: I'm alright, just tired from the walk. Nothing a nap won't fix.
marriage.Neutral_5: The river was muddy again. I'll have to clean my boots before bed.
marriage.Neutral_6: Hm, did you see where I left my putter? It was right here a minute ago.
marriage.Neutral_7: Oh, you're back. Good. Pass me the towel, would you?
marriage.Neutral_8: I'm just thinking about the next tournament. Don't mind me.
marriage.Neutral_9: The post came, and the Merchant still wants his money for the sand.
marriage.Bad_0: Not now, dear. I just lost a ball in the river and I'm in a mood.
marriage.Bad_1: Please don't touch the clubs. I'm cross and they are very sensitive.
marriage.Bad_2: I'm trying to focus, and the Princess keeps humming.
marriage.Bad_3: If one more bird lands on my tee I'm going to make it a bogey.
marriage.Bad_4: Ugh, the mud is everywhere again. My boots, my socks, my whole life.
marriage.Bad_5: I'm not angry, I'm just stuck in a bunker of a mood.
marriage.Bad_6: Sorry, I snapped. Give me a moment and I'll be better.
marriage.Bad_7: Could you knock next time? I was trying to remember my swing.
marriage.Bad_8: I know it's silly, but a bad score makes me grumpy for hours.
marriage.Bad_9: Let's talk later. I need to cool off with some lemonade first.
marriage.OneKid_0: Look at %kid1, already trying to swing a club. Little menace.
marriage.OneKid_1: %kid1 hit the wall with a ball again. Tell me that isn't your aim.
marriage.OneKid_2: %kid1 is finally asleep. A miracle, honestly.
marriage.OneKid_3: I taught %kid1 to hold a club. First lesson: keep your head down.
marriage.TwoKids_0: %kid1 and %kid2 have turned the lawn into a course. Pars for everyone.
marriage.TwoKids_1: %kid1 and %kid2 keep racing to the flag. I'm starting to lose ground.
marriage.TwoKids_2: Our two little golfers are asleep at last. Shh, don't wake them up.
marriage.TwoKids_3: %kid1 and %kid2 asked me to teach them a new trick. I'm so proud I could burst.
marriage.NoBed_0: The bed is far too comfy and I'm far too tired. I'll sleep on the couch.
marriage.NoBed_1: I'll sleep wherever I can. The couch is a fine bed for a golfer.
marriage.NoBed_2: Just a little nap on the rug. Don't tell the Princess.
marriage.NoBed_3: No bed for me tonight. The armchair is perfectly fine, dear.
marriage.patio_Alex: The patio is my favourite spot. Sit with me and watch the sun over the river.
marriage.spouseRoom_Alex: Our room is cosy. I hung my best golf poster on the wall, right beside your paintings.
marriage.funLeave_Alex: I'm off to the course for a round. Don't worry, I'll be back before the sun goes down.
marriage.funReturn_Alex: I'm back, dear. The round went alright. I only lost two balls and one hat.
marriage.Outdoor_Alex: The fresh air suits us. Let's keep walking until the bench looks tired of us.
marriage.spring_Alex: Spring is full of blossoms, and I'm full of plans for the new fairway.
marriage.summer_Alex: Summer heat means cold lemonade. Want to share a glass on the porch?
marriage.fall_Alex: Fall leaves are all over the course. I'd love to rake them together with you.
marriage.winter_Alex: Winter frost makes the grass crunch underfoot. Hold my hand and let's keep warm inside.

situations.eye: The Eye of Cthulhu is gone, @. I'm glad, it was watching my swing with far too much interest.
situations.evilBoss: The Eater of Worlds and the Brain of Cthulhu are both finished. I'd rather play a round than dig about in the dark.
situations.skeletron: Skeletron is defeated and the dungeon is open. I hear the Old Man is free at last, and he has a fine sense of humour.
situations.queenBee: The Queen Bee is down. Her hive honey is on the course for the next round, so keep your swings low around the hive.
situations.hardmode: The Wall of Flesh fell and hardmode has begun. The Hallow is spreading, and the greens look a little too glowing for comfort.
situations.mechs: A mechanical boss has been smashed to bits. Good work, but keep those gears away from my putter.
situations.plantera: Plantera is defeated and the jungle temple is open. Give the jungle a wide berth, the vines are harder to play through than rough.
situations.golem: The Golem is defeated. Temple stone everywhere, but the new fairway is looking good.
situations.cultist: The Lunatic Cultist is gone and the celestial pillars are rising. They make a wonderful backdrop for a round of golf.
situations.moonLord: The Moon Lord is defeated. The sky is finally quiet, and I can hit balls into it without a worry in the world.
situations.goblins: We repelled the goblin army. They tried to nick my clubs, but my driver put a stop to that.
situations.pirates: The pirates are beaten. Did you see them run from my swing? Pure drama.
situations.frostLegion: The Frost Legion is gone. I can finally play a round without icicles in my hair.
situations.martians: The Martian Madness is over. Ray guns and golf balls do not mix, so I'm glad they've gone.
situations.bloodMoon: There was a blood moon last night. Golf in red light is a terrible idea, so I stayed in and polished my clubs.
situations.eclipse: The solar eclipse turned the course dark last night. I missed three putts and blame the sky entirely.
situations.party: The Party Girl is throwing a party today. I'll bring a club and a bottle, but please keep the pinata away from my putter.

festivals.spring13: The Egg Festival! The Princess hides her eggs under my hats, so I'm hunting all over the place. Did you find any golden ones?$h
festivals.spring24: The Flower Dance. I'm no dancer, but I'll spin you around if you ask nicely. Mind your toes, I'm still learning.$l
festivals.summer11: The Luau soup is ready, and I added a splash of honey to the community pot. Don't tell the Nurse, she says it spoils the taste.
festivals.summer28: The jellies are glowing on the beach tonight. I've never seen anything so calm. Makes a golfer want to put his club down for once.$l
festivals.fall16: The Stardew Valley Fair! I entered the putting contest and won a ribbon, mostly because the Princess let me cheat a little.$h
festivals.fall27: Spirit's Eve. The maze is spooky and I got lost twice. Still, nothing scares me like a slice into the rough.$u
festivals.winter8: The Festival of Ice. I tried to build a golf course out of snow. It looks more like a bunker with a flag stuck in it.$h
festivals.winter25: Secret gift exchanges are the best. I'm giving a golf ball with a little drawing on it. Shh, keep the secret.$h
festivals.spring13_spouse: The Egg Festival, and my favourite egg hunter is by my side. Found any golden ones yet, dear?$l
festivals.spring24_spouse: Dancing with you at the Flower Dance is the only dance I'm any good at. Keep your toes safe, please.$l
festivals.summer11_spouse: I stirred the Luau soup for you and the Princess. You owe me a bowl of your own cooking.$h
festivals.summer28_spouse: Under the glowing jellies you look even better than the view. I'm the luckiest golfer in the valley.$l
festivals.fall16_spouse: We entered the Fair together and won a ribbon for teamwork. Let's frame it next to our wedding photo.$h
festivals.fall27_spouse: Spirit's Eve with you is far less scary. I still got lost in the maze, but you found me.$h
festivals.winter8_spouse: Our snow sculpture looks like a golf flag, and it's leaning. Just like me when I'm in love.$l
festivals.winter25_spouse: My gift for you is a golf ball with a tiny heart drawn on it. Please don't lose it in the river.$l

loved.text: Oh, @! Now that is a proper gift. Hold on, I need to admire it for a full minute before I do anything else.$h

liked.text: Nice. This is the sort of thing I'd buy for myself after a good round.$h

neutral.text: Thanks, @. I'll find a good spot for it on the mantel.

disliked.text: Hm. Not really a golfer's kind of thing, @. I'm going to put it in the rough and pretend it never happened.$s

hated.text: Are you trying to ruin my swing? Take that back before the Princess sees it!$a

help: Help! Something is after my good trousers!
Fore! Fore! Somebody get this thing off my green!
Help, help! It's coming for my golf bag!
thanks: Oh, @, thank goodness. My heart is still doing a backswing.$h
I owe you a drink at the saloon, @. Something soft and cold, and I'm paying for once.$h
battle: Stay back! I have... a golf ball!
Take this! Oh, it barely even dented it!
Fore! Fore! Please just go away!
I'm very brave! Mostly from over here!
courage.hurt: Ow. I've been knocked flat, @. Put me on the sofa with a lemonade and don't mind the bruise on my dignity.$s

danger.boss: A boss is loose and I'm not going anywhere near the course. Please, @, stay between me and the big scary thing.$s
danger.invasion: An army is marching this way! I've bolted every window and I'm hiding in the cupboard with my clubs.$u
danger.pumpkinMoon: The pumpkin moon is up and the scarecrows keep staring at my hat. I'm not leaving the house.$s
danger.frostMoon: The frost moon is out and the snowmen have my best driver. I'm staying under three blankets, @.$s
danger.eclipse: The sky has gone dark and those eclipse things are out. I'm hiding behind my golf bag, @!$u
danger.bloodMoon: Blood moon tonight, @. The red light makes my golf balls look like tomatoes. Stay close, please.$s

events.after: Don't tell the Princess about the rug. She'll make me roll it up every evening.

steps.say: Oh! @, you startled me. Don't mind the rug, I'm practising my swing on it.$u
Watch the ball, keep your head down, and follow right through. That's the whole secret.$h

answers.reply: Ha! Then you're already a better player than most of this town.$h
No matter. I'll teach you the basics, one swing at a time.$h

steps.say: Next time hold the club by the grip. The head is for hitting balls, not for waving at the Princess.

events.after: Next time I'll let you take the first shot. Honest. Mostly.

steps.say: @! Perfect timing. I need a helper to hold the flag while I putt.$h
Hold it straight, not that way. The wind keeps pushing the flag over.$u
There. Par three, and that flag is not going anywhere.$h
Here, you try it. Put the ball down gently and let the club do the work.#$b#Yes, you can lean a little. Most people do, and I won't tell.$l
Nice shot, @. You've got a natural swing. Honestly, I think I'm in trouble now.$l
@! Lovely to see you. My housemate here has been talking about you all morning.
It is true, I have been rather fond of the garden you tended by the river.$h
We share 1 River Road, and she always tells me to stop talking about golf.$h
He never stops talking about golf, @. Do not encourage him.$h

steps.question: Would you like to join us for a round?

answers.reply: Splendid! Bring your best swing and your sturdiest shoes.$h
That is fine. The course will still be waiting for you.$h

events.after: I'll be thinking about that sunset all week long.

steps.say: @, I've taken a swing every night this week, and I still can't stop looking at you instead of the hole.$l

answers.reply: Ha! Then you'd better keep watching. My swing is getting worse by the minute.$l
The stars are beautiful, but I'd rather be looking at you under them.$l

steps.say: The sea is so calm tonight. I want you beside me for every sunset from now on.$l
Thank you for being here, @. I mean it.$h
@, I'm not going to make a golf joke tonight. I've practised a speech all week and it's gone clean out of my head.$u
The valley feels like home because you are part of it. I want to keep that feeling every single day.$l

steps.question: Will you go on a proper date with me?

answers.reply: Wonderful. I'll bring the good snacks and only a few bad jokes.$l
Fair enough. I'll be here practising my speech.$h

steps.say: Good night, @. Thank you for listening to my nervous rambling.$l
Good morning, @. I made breakfast, and I did not burn the eggs this time.$h
This house feels like a proper round of golf. Every corner has something we built together.$l
Come on, sit. The Princess sent a note saying she's delighted for us both.$h
I'm so glad you're mine, @. Every morning I wake up grateful, and every evening I'm even more so.$l
